title: Canonical direct image on the small etale topoi of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X,Y$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ with their small etale sites [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism. Use the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]: for schemes in universe $u$, the set-valued sheaves take values in $\mathrm{Type}_{\max(u+1,w)}$, for arbitrary $w$. Write $\mathcal C_X$ for the enlarged etale site with objects chartwise etale algebraic spaces $T\to X$ (meaning that every representable etale scheme chart $U\to T$ has representable etale composite $U\to X$), arrows over $X$, and jointly surjective etale coverings, and similarly for $Y$. Let $R_X:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C_X)\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}})$ denote restriction to scheme objects. The canonical small etale direct image functor on sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] is defined by $f_*=R_Y\circ v_{f,*}\circ R_X^{-1}$, where $v_f:\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal C_X$ sends $V$ to $X\times_Y V$ and $v_{f,*}$ is precomposition with $v_f^{\mathrm{op}}$, so that $(v_{f,*}F)(V)=F(X\times_Y V)$. The comparison inverses are the inverses of these restriction equivalences. This defines the specified functor for every $f$, without assuming representability or etaleness of $f$.
